company.name: DigixSquad
company.tagline: Your IT team, without the hiring hassle.

hero.headline: Your IT team, ready in days. Not months.
hero.subheadline: Hire a skilled professional or a complete squad on a monthly contract. We hire, train, manage and pay. You get the work done.

about.story: DigixSquad was started to solve a problem every department and company in Pakistan knows well: digital work can't wait, but hiring takes months, training costs money and good people leave. We built a bench of skilled IT professionals and organized them into ready-to-deploy squads, so our clients can start the work right away and pay one simple monthly fee.
about.mission: To give every organization, from government departments to growing businesses, instant access to skilled and managed IT teams, so they can deliver digital projects without the cost, delay and risk of hiring.
about.vision: To be Pakistan's most trusted squad-as-a-service partner, powering digital transformation across the public and private sectors and taking Pakistani tech talent to the world.

why_us.title: No hiring hassle
why_us.description: No recruitment, training, payroll or HR. We handle all of it.

why_us.title: Ready in days
why_us.description: Vetted professionals from our bench, matched to your requirement.

why_us.title: Flexible monthly contracts
why_us.description: One month or twelve. Monthly or project-based. On-site or remote.

why_us.title: Free replacement
why_us.description: Not the right fit? We replace the resource at no extra cost.

why_us.title: Managed delivery
why_us.description: Every squad comes with a lead or PM, so you manage outcomes, not people.

why_us.title: Government-ready
why_us.description: PPRA-compliant procurement support, registered entity and NDA-backed data security.

process.title: Tell us what you need
process.description: Fill the request form with roles, duration and work mode.

process.title: We match the right people
process.description: We shortlist from our bench and share profiles within days.

process.title: Onboard and start
process.description: Sign a simple monthly contract. The squad starts on-site or remote.

process.title: Monthly delivery and reporting

process.title: Renew, scale or wrap up

compliance.title: PPRA-compliant procurement

compliance.title: Registered entity

compliance.title: NDA and data confidentiality

compliance.title: Secure infrastructure
compliance.description: Encrypted storage and backups, with on-premise deployment available on request.

faqs.question: What is a squad?
faqs.answer: A small team of 3 to 8 professionals with all the roles a project needs, provided on a monthly fee. You don't hire, train or pay salaries; we do.

faqs.question: Can I hire just one person?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can request a single role, such as a QA tester or a Power BI developer, for as little as one month.

faqs.question: Will the team work on-site or remotely?
faqs.answer: Either. Choose on-site, remote or hybrid when you submit your request.

faqs.question: How quickly can you deploy?
faqs.answer: Most single roles are deployed within 7 to 14 days. Full squads depend on size and skills.

faqs.question: Do you work with government departments?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support PPRA procurement processes, provide registration documents, and sign NDAs for data security.

faqs.question: What if a resource isn't the right fit?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we'll replace them at no extra cost.
